realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Bureaucrat
primary.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
primary.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
primary.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

secondary.label: Sage
secondary.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
secondary.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.central_question: Should we preserve the system, or change it?

growth.label: Sage
growth.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
growth.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
growth.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

other_ally.label: Judge
other_ally.description: Weighs fairness deliberately; authority must be earned, not assumed.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I hold the scale steady, even when the verdict costs me.
other_ally.shadow_description: Hides behind the letter of the rule to avoid the harder, human work of mercy.

quarter.label: Architect
quarter.description: Designs systems meant to outlast the person who built them.
quarter.guiding_promise: I design what outlasts me — and that is enough.
quarter.shadow_description: Falls in love with the design and forgets the people who have to live inside it.

opposite.label: Reformer
opposite.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
opposite.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Judge — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
